test_name: Validate Adding a New Rooster User
description: This test verifies that an admin can successfully add a new user by filling out a form and submitting it.
steps: Navigate to the Admin Dashboard page.
Locate and click on the 'Add Roosters' button.
Verify that the user creation form is displayed.
Fill out the username field with 'new_user'.
Fill out the email field with 'new_user@example.com'.
Click the 'Submit' button to add the user.
Verify that a success message appears after submission.
Check that the new user 'new_user' is visible in the user list.
expected_results: Admin successfully adds a new user.
New user appears in the user list.
edge_cases: Form validation fails due to missing required fields.
Role dropdown does not load options.
data_requirements: List of predefined roles for dropdown.
Mocked backend responses for user creation.
Error handling data for validation testing.
dependencies: Admin user must be logged in.
Form elements must be functional and visible.
Backend API must support user creation.
api_interactions: GET request to refresh user list.
performance_metrics: Page refresh speed after user addition.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure form labels are accessible via screen readers.
Verify keyboard navigation for form fields.
Check error message visibility and contrast.
